title: Girls in Motion Puzzle Vol. 2: Body Special 264
overview:
Enjoy the dynamite bodies of gravure queens "Akiko Hinagata", "China Matsuda" and "Akira Kiuchi" in three kinds of puzzle modes.

Body Special 264, the second Girls in Motion Puzzle, is a jigsaw puzzle game built around video and photos of three swimsuit models.

- Movie Puzzle: assemble jigsaws made from clear full-motion video while recorded voices cheer you on, with a surprise waiting when you clear a scene
- VS Puzzle: take on Hina, China or Akira, or battle a friend. Place the most pieces before time runs out to win, and use items to heat up the fight
- Puzzle Club: pick a favorite sexy shot of one of the three and finish the still-image puzzle at your own pace. Solve it fast and she greets you with a special message
- One or two players, Shuttle Mouse compatible, memory backup saves

グラビアクイーン「雛形あきこ」「松田千奈」「木内あきら」のダイナマイトボディを3種類のパズルモードで楽しもう。
